name: Modern Table Lamp
description: Table lamp with contemporary design combining elegance and functionality. The matte black metal base contrasts with the cream fabric diffuser, creating sophisticated ambient lighting. Ideal for nightstands, offices, and modern living rooms.
full_description: This table lamp was designed for those who value detail and good taste. The matte black lacquered metal structure offers durability and a premium appearance, while the cream fabric shade provides soft and cozy light. At just 45 cm in height, it fits perfectly on any surface without taking up too much space. Compatible with E27 bulbs up to 40W (not included), adaptable to LED. Textile cord included with rope switch. A touch of sophistication for any room.

name: Natural Linen Pillow
description: Handcrafted pillow in 100% natural linen with rustic and elegant texture. The organic cotton filling ensures lasting comfort and shape. Available in natural beige tone, works with any decorative style from Scandinavian to Mediterranean.
full_description: Produced in Portugal by local craftsmen, this natural linen pillow is the perfect complement for sofas, chairs, and beds. The high-quality linen fabric is breathable, hypoallergenic, and becomes softer with use. The organic cotton fiber filling maintains its shape over time. The discrete button closure makes it easy to wash the cover. Dimensions: 45x45 cm. Machine washable at 30°C. A piece that unites Portuguese textile tradition with contemporary design.

name: Handcrafted Ceramic Vase
description: Hand-made ceramic vase with handcrafted glaze finish in terracotta and white tones. Each piece is unique, with small imperfections that testify to its manual origin. Perfect for plants, dried flowers, or simply as a decorative element.
full_description: Created by Portuguese potters in the Caldas da Rainha region, this vase combines traditional techniques with contemporary sensibility. The glaze is applied by hand, creating unique gradients varying between warm terracotta and cream white. With 22 cm height and 14 cm diameter, it's ideal for small to medium plants. Bottom with drainage hole. Not dishwasher safe. The slightly rough texture evokes the raw material of Alentejo earth. A functional work of art.

name: Golden Round Mirror
description: Circular mirror with brushed gold metal frame, 60 cm diameter. The matte finish of the gold is sophisticated and current, far from the shiny golds of the 90s. Includes wall hanging system for mounting in any orientation.
full_description: This round mirror is one of the most versatile pieces in interior decoration — works well in hallways, living rooms, bedrooms, and even bathrooms. The metal frame with matte gold finish measures 5 cm in width, creating an elegant and robust framing. 5 mm glass with soft anti-reflective treatment. The included mounting kit supports concrete, masonry, and drywall. Total dimension: 60 cm diameter. Weight: 3.2 kg. A statement piece that makes any room look larger and brighter.

name: Wooden Candle Holders
description: Set of 3 candle holders in acacia wood with different heights, for votive and pillar candles. The natural finish highlights the grain of the wood. Creates a cohesive and organic composition on any surface.
full_description: This set of candle holders was designed to create a visually rich table center or sideboard with minimal effort. The three pieces have heights of 8, 12, and 16 cm, allowing for interesting height variations. Acacia wood is known for its durability and the beauty of its unique grain patterns. Finished with natural oil, without synthetic varnishes. Compatible with 4 to 6 cm diameter candles. Easy to clean with a damp cloth. Do not expose to excessive moisture. Sold as a set of 3.

name: Organic Cotton T-Shirt
description: Oversized t-shirt in 100% GOTS-certified organic cotton. The relaxed fit and fabric weight (280g/m²) provide a premium silhouette. Available in 8 neutral season colors, from off-white to charcoal.
full_description: Made with organic cotton certified by GOTS (Global Organic Textile Standard), this t-shirt is soft to the touch, durable, and produced without harmful pesticides. The 280g/m² fabric has a structured drape that avoids the cheap appearance typical of thin cottons. Reinforced stitching at shoulders and neckline. Available in sizes XS to XXL. Machine washable at 30°C. Made in Portugal — each piece includes a card with the name of the seamstress who produced it. Fashion that respects those who make it.

name: Relaxed Linen Pants
description: Pure linen pants with relaxed fit and elastic waistband. Fresh, elegant, and versatile — they work in casual settings as well as a summer dinner. Linen gains character with use, softening and developing unique lightness.
full_description: Linen is the most refreshing textile fiber that exists, and these pants demonstrate why the Portuguese have always loved it. The relaxed fit with some volume in the legs and slightly tapered ankle creates a balanced silhouette. Two functional side pockets with real depth. Belt loops. Composition: 100% linen. Sizes 34 to 46. Being pure linen, expect some natural wrinkling — it's part of the fabric's character. Wash at 30°C or hand wash.

name: Printed Silk Scarf
description: Square scarf in 100% natural silk with floral print inspired by Portuguese 18th-century tiles. Can be worn around the neck, in the hair, on the bag, or framed as artwork. Dimensions: 90x90 cm.
full_description: Each scarf is digitally printed on 12-momme Habotai silk, which combines lightness with resistance. The pattern was developed by a Portuguese graphic designer in collaboration with the National Tile Museum in Lisbon. Colors are fixed with a high-temperature vapor process, ensuring they don't fade in the first few washes. Instructions: hand wash or dry cleaning recommended. Presented in an elegant gift box — perfect as a gift.

name: Hand-Embroidered Cap
description: 6-panel cap in cotton gabardine with handcrafted embroidery on the front. The embroidery represents a stylized seagull — a symbol of Portuguese coastal identity. Adjustable back taffeta closure. Machine washable.
full_description: The caps in our artisanal line are hand-embroidered by seamstresses in the Viana do Castelo region, with a minimum of 2 hours of work per piece. The 260g/m² cotton gabardine is sturdy and holds its shape. The embroidery uses mercerized cotton thread that never loses its texture. One-size adjustable. Available in black, white, and moss green. Each cap comes with a sewn label with the name of the artisan who embroidered it. An accessory that tells a story.

name: Vegan Leather Tote Bag
description: Tote bag in high-quality vegan leather with granulated texture that imitates leather with great fidelity. Spacious enough for everyday use, with interior compartment with closure and smartphone pocket. Double long handles.
full_description: Produced with APPLE SKIN material — an innovative material made from apple juice production waste — this bag is sustainable, durable, and premium in appearance. The interior in black synthetic suede facilitates locating objects. The bag measures 38x32x10 cm and comfortably fits a 13-inch laptop. Includes exterior pocket with magnet. Reinforced handles support up to 8 kg. Available in black, camel, and wine. A serious bag for serious use.

name: Rosehip Serum
description: Facial serum with 98% natural ingredients and cold-pressed rosehip oil as the star ingredient. Regenerating, illuminating, and antioxidant. Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. 30 ml.
full_description: The rosehip oil used in this serum is cold-pressed from fruits of the Rosa rubiginosa species cultivated sustainably in Chile. The formulation combines this active ingredient with dual molecular weight hyaluronic acid, stabilized vitamin C, and Portuguese aloe vera extract. Fast absorption and dry texture — doesn't leave skin oily. Visible results in 4 weeks: increased luminosity and uniform texture. Dermatologically tested. Vegan & cruelty-free. Without parabens, sulfates, or silicones.

name: Natural Lip Balm
description: Stick lip balm with 100% natural formula: Portuguese beeswax, shea butter, coconut oil, and Alentejo honey extract. Hydrates and protects without leaving a sticky feeling. Soft aroma of honey and vanilla.
full_description: Hand-made in small batches in a certified laboratory in Évora, this balm uses only ingredients you recognize. The beeswax comes from beekeeper partners in the Alentejo, ensuring complete traceability. The virgin coconut oil and unrefined shea butter provide intense, long-lasting hydration. The organic honey adds regenerating properties. Without dyes, synthetic fragrances, parabens, or silicones. Biodegradable cardboard packaging. Weight: 4.5g. Vegan product: NO (contains beeswax).

name: Organic Argan Oil
description: Pure and organic argan oil, extracted by cold pressing argan nuts from Morocco. Multi-purpose: face, hair, and body. Certified organic by Ecocert. 50 ml in bottle with dropper.
full_description: This argan oil is extracted by certified Moroccan women's cooperatives, ensuring sustainable practices and fair trade. Cold pressing preserves all essential fatty acids, vitamin E, and squalene. For the face, apply 3-4 drops before moisturizer as a nourishing serum. For hair, apply to damp ends or use as an overnight mask on ends. For the body, apply after bathing for deep hydration. Fast absorption, no oily residue. Certifications: Ecocert Cosmos Organic, Vegan.

name: Facial Care Kit
description: Complete skincare kit with 4 products from the same line: gentle gel cleanser, balancing toner, vitamin C serum, and SPF 20 moisturizer. Formulated for an effective and simplified AM/PM routine. Ideal for normal to combination skin.
full_description: This kit was created by a Portuguese dermatologist to simplify your skincare routine without compromising results. The cleanser removes impurities without disrupting the skin barrier. The toner balances pH. The stabilized vitamin C serum (L-ascorbyl glucoside) illuminates and protects against free radicals. The SPF 20 moisturizer protects and hydrates simultaneously. All products are compatible with each other and can be used morning and evening. Without parabens, without silicones. Cruelty-free. Dermatologically tested. Total volume: 4x30ml.

name: Portuguese Floral Perfume
description: 50 ml Eau de Parfum with floral composition inspired by the gardens of Serra de Sintra. Top notes of bergamot and violet leaf. Heart of damascena rose and Portuguese jasmine. Base of sandalwood and white musk.
full_description: Created by an independent Lisbon perfumer in collaboration with aromatic flower producers from the Algarve, this perfume is an ode to Portuguese gardens. Each batch of raw material is manually selected to ensure consistency. The Eau de Parfum concentration (18%) ensures longevity of 6-8 hours on skin. The bottle in heavy glass with gold cap is refillable — a sustainable choice. Production in limited batches of 200 units per semester. For those who appreciate discreet luxury and Portuguese identity.

name: Portable Bluetooth Speaker
description: Bluetooth 5.0 speaker with 360° sound and 12W power. Water-resistant IPX6, 20-hour battery life. Compact cylindrical design in anodized aluminum. USB-C charging. Ideal for indoor and outdoor use.
full_description: This speaker combines portability, durability, and sound quality in a balanced way. The 45mm driver with passive radiator produces surprising bass for its size. DSP technology automatically adjusts equalization to volume. Bluetooth 5.0 connectivity with 15-meter range. 3.5mm auxiliary input for devices without Bluetooth. Full charge in 2 hours via USB-C. Includes carry strap. Dimensions: 7 cm diameter x 18 cm height. Weight: 420g. Available in black, gray, and green.

name: 15W Wireless Charger
description: Qi-certified wireless charger with maximum power of 15W. Compatible with all Qi smartphones, including iPhone 12-15 and Samsung Galaxy S20+. Flat base with non-slip surface in vegan leather. Discrete status LED.
full_description: This charger supports fast charging modes of 15W for Samsung, 12W for Huawei, and 7.5W for Apple, automatically adapting. The large charging coil (68mm) makes device alignment easy. The protection chip against overcharge, overheating, and overvoltage protects your device's battery long-term. The black vegan leather surface offers premium aesthetics on your desk. 18W wall adapter not included (compatible with any PD charger). USB-A to USB-C cable included.

name: Noise-Canceling Headphones
description: Over-ear headphones with 3-level active noise cancellation (ANC), Bluetooth 5.2, 35-hour battery life, and collapsible for transport. Detailed sound with 40mm drivers. Microphone for calls with ambient noise reduction.
full_description: Active noise cancellation uses 4 microphones to analyze and neutralize up to 92% of ambient noise, making them ideal for work, travel, and study. The 40mm drivers with composite diaphragm produce balanced sound with controlled bass and crisp highs. The 'transparency' mode lets you hear your surroundings without removing the headphones. Multi-point connection with 2 devices simultaneously. Memory foam leather ear cushions. Includes USB-C cable and auxiliary cable. The 35-hour battery lasts a week of intensive use without charging.

name: 4K Action Camera
description: Action camera with 4K/60fps recording, 6-axis EIS stabilization, and water resistance to 10 meters without case. 2-inch rear touchscreen. Built-in Wi-Fi for immediate sharing. Battery with 2.5 hours of recording.
full_description: This camera was developed for adventurers who don't want to compromise on image quality. The 20MP sensor with f/2.8 captures exceptional detail. The 6-axis EIS stabilization eliminates blur in running, cycling, and surfing. Capture modes include: 4K/60fps video, time-lapse, 1080p/240fps slow motion, and night mode. The touchscreen interface is intuitive even with gloves. Includes: 2 batteries, dual charger, head mount, chest mount, and protective case. Compatible with all accessories from the previous line.

name: Sports Smartwatch
description: Smartwatch with integrated GPS, continuous heart rate monitor, SpO2, over 100 sports modes, and 14-day battery life. 1.43-inch AMOLED screen. 5ATM water resistance. Smartphone notifications.
full_description: Designed for athletes and fitness enthusiasts who demand accurate data. Dual-band GPS (L1+L5) provides precise location even in dense urban areas. The optical heart monitor uses 6 LEDs for reliable measurements during intense exercise. The SpO2 sensor monitors blood oxygen saturation 24/7. Among 100+ sports modes are running, swimming, cycling, yoga, climbing, and more. The 500mAh battery lasts 14 days in normal use or 40 hours with GPS active. Full magnetic charge in 2 hours. Includes 2 interchangeable bands.

name: Alentejo Rosemary Honey
description: Monofloral rosemary honey harvested in Upper Alentejo beehives by family beekeepers. Light amber color, intense aroma, and sweet flavor with a slight herbal touch. 350g in reusable glass jar.
full_description: Alentejo rosemary honey is considered one of the world's best for its purity and aromatic complexity. The beehives are located in a natural reserve more than 5 km from any intensive cultivation. Extraction is done cold, preserving all enzymes, antioxidants, and antimicrobial properties. Natural crystallization is a sign of quality — simply heat gently in a water bath to restore fluid texture. Traceable batch with hive number and extraction date engraved on the cap. Certified by the National Beekeeping Center.

name: Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil 500ml
description: Early harvest extra virgin olive oil, monovarietal Galega, certified organic. Acidity below 0.2%. Intense fruity, bitter, and peppery. Produced in Ribatejo under certified organic agriculture.
full_description: Early harvest (before the olive fully matures) maximizes polyphenols and antioxidants, resulting in a more intense-flavored oil with greater health benefits. The Galega variety is native Portuguese with characteristic notes of grass and green tomato on the nose. Produced on a family estate with over 200 years of history. Cold-pressed within 2 hours of harvest. Bottle in dark glass to preserve properties. Acidity: 0.18%. Peroxide index: 8 meq/kg. Ideal raw over toasts, salads, and fish.

name: Green Tea with Mint 20 Tea Bags
description: Blend of Japanese green sencha tea with fresh Portuguese mint, dehydrated at low temperature. Refreshing hot and delicious as a cold infusion. Biodegradable packaging. 20 pyramid tea bags in corn mesh.
full_description: The selected green sencha tea comes from plantations in the Shizuoka region of Japan, harvested in the first spring flush. The mint is cultivated in Minho and dehydrated at 38°C to preserve essential oils and vibrant aroma. The blend results in a refreshing beverage, rich in antioxidant catechins. The pyramid tea bags in corn starch mesh allow the leaves to fully expand, extracting all the complexity of flavor. Ideal temperature: 75-80°C. Brewing time: 2-3 minutes. You can add honey and lemon.

name: Portuguese Spices Collection
description: Collection of 6 iconic Portuguese spices: smoked paprika, sweet paprika, Ceylon cinnamon, turmeric, Algarve flower salt, and saffron. In reusable glass jars with bamboo lids. Gift box included.
full_description: This collection brings together the spices that define Portuguese gastronomy flavors — from cod to chorizo, from chicken to cataplana. Each spice is selected for origin and quality: smoked paprika is from Murcia, paprika is genuine Portuguese, cinnamon is from Ceylon (not cassia), and flower salt is from Castro Marim marshes. The 50ml glass jars are reusable and re-labelable. The natural pine wood box serves as a spice rack after use. A perfect gift for those who enjoy cooking.

name: Handcrafted Fig Jam
description: Traditional fig jam made with fresh figs of the Pingo de Mel variety from the Algarve, slowly cooked with cane sugar and lemon. Rich and concentrated texture. Ideal with cheeses, pork, and artisanal toast. 220g.
full_description: The figs used in this jam are of the Pingo de Mel variety — the sweetest and most flavorful of Algarve figs — manually harvested in September. The recipe remains unchanged for three generations: figs, integral cane sugar, lemon juice, and a pinch of sea salt. Slow cooking in a copper pot for 4 hours concentrates natural sugars and creates the characteristic velvety texture. Without dyes, preservatives, or added pectin. After opening, store in the refrigerator for up to 4 weeks. Certified as Artisanal Product by DGADR.

name: Premium Yoga Mat
description: Yoga mat in natural rubber with embossed non-slip surface. 183x61 cm, 5mm thick. Absorbs sweat and maintains grip even during intense practice. Includes carrying strap.
full_description: This yoga mat was designed for serious practitioners who demand stability and comfort. The top surface in TPE with fine texture offers exceptional grip in balance poses and quick transitions. The FSC-certified natural rubber base provides floor isolation and joint cushioning. The 5mm thickness is the perfect balance between comfort and proprioceptive stability. Embroidered alignment marks for correct positioning. Hand washable with neutral detergent. Weight: 1.8 kg. Includes adjustable shoulder strap.

name: 750ml Thermal Bottle
description: Bottle in 18/8 stainless steel with double-wall vacuum insulation. Keeps drinks hot for 12 hours and cold for 24 hours. Wide mouth for easy filling and cleaning. BPA-free. Sealed screw cap. Available in 6 colors.
full_description: Made in food-grade 18/8 stainless steel (lead-free, BPA-free), this bottle is compatible with coffee, tea, juices, and carbonated water. The double-wall vacuum insulation creates a thermal barrier that keeps drinks hot up to 12 hours at 60°C+ and cold up to 24 hours below 6°C. The wide 55mm mouth accepts ice cubes and facilitates cleaning. The screw cap includes a silicone gasket that prevents leaks even when inverted. The exterior with matte epoxy powder is scratch-resistant. Capacity: 750ml. Weight: 320g. 5-year warranty.

name: Resistance Bands Set
description: Set of 5 resistance bands in natural latex with different resistance levels: extra light (8kg), light (14kg), medium (20kg), strong (28kg), and extra strong (35kg). Includes carry bag and exercise guide.
full_description: Resistance bands are one of the most versatile and complete training tools. This 5-level set allows for gradual progression and full-body training — from warm-up with the extra light to intensive strengthening with the extra strong. Made in highly elastic natural latex, each band is 208cm long when closed. Ends are reinforced to prevent breakage. Ideal for strength training, rehabilitation, advanced yoga, and stretching. The exercise guide includes 30 exercises with photos and execution descriptions. Suitable for all levels.

name: 25L Trail Backpack
description: Technical backpack for trail running and hiking, 25 liters, with hydration system compatible with 2L reservoir (not included). Ventilated AirMesh back, side trekking supports, and compression straps. Weight: 780g.
full_description: Designed with input from Portuguese trail runners from Serra da Estrela, this backpack balances capacity and lightness. The main fabric in 210D ripstop nylon is abrasion-resistant and water-repellent (DWR). The ventilated back with perforated foam and AirMesh lumbar panel reduce heat and sweat on long climbs. Internal organization includes: main compartment with hydration pocket, front pocket with organization (keys, phone, snacks), two side pockets for poles, and quick-access pocket on upper flap. Compatible with rain cover (included). Sizes S/M and M/L.

name: Professional Jump Rope
description: Jump rope with steel cable coated in PVC and high-speed ball bearings. Adjustable cable (max. 3m). Ergonomic handles with EVA foam. Ideal for CrossFit, boxing, and high-intensity cardio.
full_description: The coated steel cable is 40% faster than conventional nylon ropes, making double-unders easier. The 608ZZ ball bearings ensure smooth, frictionless rotation. Cable length adjustment is made by a thumb screw without tools. The EVA non-slip handles maintain firm grip even with sweaty hands. Total weight: 185g. This rope is used by CrossFit athletes, boxers, and jump rope fitness practitioners. The cable is replaceable (sold separately). Includes carry bag.

name: The Alchemist - Special Edition
description: Collector's edition of Paulo Coelho's bestselling novel, with hardcover in embroidered linen, silk bookmark, and cream-colored paper. Includes an unpublished preface from the author about the work's 35 years. In European Portuguese.
full_description: This anniversary special edition was produced in a limited run of 5000 numbered copies. The natural linen cover with gold-embossed title is protected by a dust jacket illustrated by a Portuguese plastic artist. The 90g/m² paper with cream tone is more comfortable for extended reading. The text uses the spelling prior to the 1990 Orthographic Agreement — a deliberate choice to preserve the original musical quality of the language. Includes a 20-page analysis of the work's symbols and themes. An object to keep for generations.

name: Beginner's Meditation Guide
description: Practical guide to mindfulness meditation written by a Portuguese teacher certified by Oxford University. 200 pages with 40 guided practices via QR code. From beginner to advanced. No mysticism — based on scientific evidence.
full_description: This book was born from 15 years of practice and 10 years of teaching meditation in corporate, hospital, and school settings in Portugal. The approach is scientific: each technique is presented based on research support (neuroscience, clinical psychology, and medicine). QR codes throughout the book provide access to 40 guided practice audios of 5 to 30 minutes, narrated by the author himself. Chapters include: Fundamentals, Breath Awareness, Body Scan, Loving-Kindness Meditation, Movement Meditation, and Daily Application. Ideal as your first book on the subject.

name: Portuguese Grandmother's Recipes
description: Cookbook with 120 traditional Portuguese recipes collected from grandmothers in 18 different municipalities. With history and cultural context of each recipe. Full-page photography for each dish. Hardcover.
full_description: Over 3 years, the author — a food journalist from Porto — traveled throughout mainland Portugal and the islands to collect recipes from grandmothers over 70 years old. The result is a repository of knowledge at risk of being lost. Each recipe is accompanied by a photo of the grandmother who shared it, the family's story, and regional context. Recipes include appetizers, soups, fish, meat, vegetables, desserts, and preserves — with versions adapted for modern kitchens without losing the essence. A book that is simultaneously a cookbook and an ethnographic document.

name: Illustrated World Atlas
description: Large-format world atlas (30x38 cm) with over 200 original illustrations, detailed topographic maps, and infographics on culture, fauna, gastronomy, and history of each world region. 384 pages, hardcover.
full_description: This atlas took five years to produce by a team of 12 cartographers, illustrators, and researchers. It goes beyond a conventional atlas: each continent has thematic maps on languages, religions, gastronomy, biodiversity, music, and traditions. The original illustrations were created specifically for this volume by artists from 30 countries. The text is in European Portuguese, with a glossary of geographic terms and a detailed index of over 2000 entries. Dimensions: 30x38 cm, weight 2.4 kg. A reference and decoration object for any library.

name: Learn Python in 30 Days
description: Practical Python programming guide for beginners, structured in 30 daily lessons of 45 minutes. Code available in a GitHub repository. Progressive exercises with commented solutions. Focused on real applications: data, web, and automation.
full_description: Written by a Portuguese software engineer with 15 years of experience at companies like Unbabel and Feedzai, this book was tested with over 500 students in workshops. The 'learn by doing' methodology ensures each lesson ends with a functional mini-project. The 30 chapters cover: data types, flow control, functions, OOP, files, REST APIs, pandas, matplotlib, and task automation. Code for all examples and exercises is on GitHub and updated for Python 3.12. Includes appendix of online resources and how to keep learning after the book.

name: 100-Piece Wooden Puzzle
description: Puzzle in birch wood laser-cut with unique-shaped pieces (animals, letters, flowers). Lisbon illustration in colorful art deco style. Suitable from age 6. Includes storage board with lid.
full_description: Unlike conventional puzzles, this wooden puzzle has unique-shaped pieces — some are animal silhouettes, others have decorative cutouts — making the experience richer and the result more beautiful. The illustration was created by a Lisbon illustrator and shows iconic Lisbon points in art deco style: the Belém Tower, tram 28, the Castle of São Jorge, and the 25th of April Bridge. The wood is FSC-certified, laser-cut with precision, and painted with non-toxic watercolor paints. The storage board becomes a frame to display the completed puzzle.

name: Children's Painting Kit
description: Complete painting kit with 24 non-toxic finger paints, 6 brushes of different sizes, 10 cotton canvases 15x20cm, reusable palettes, and apron. Suitable for children ages 3-10. Washable paints.
full_description: This kit was developed with input from early childhood educators and occupational therapists to maximize creative development. The finger paints have ideal consistency — not too liquid or too thick — and are formulated with non-toxic mineral pigments, certified EN71. The 300g/m² cotton canvases have enough texture for brush and palette knife techniques. The polyester apron with front pocket effectively protects clothing. The kit also includes a guide with 8 illustrated painting techniques for children. Perfect for creative activity at home or school.

name: Organic Bear Plush
description: Bear plush in GOTS-certified organic cotton, filling in recycled cotton fiber. No loose plastic eyes — embroidered eyes. Suitable for newborns. Machine washable at 40°C. Height: 35 cm.
full_description: Designed to be a baby's first friend, this bear was thought through in every safety detail. The exterior fabric in GOTS-certified organic cotton is soft, hypoallergenic, and free from harmful substances (Oeko-Tex Standard 100 certified). The recycled cotton fiber filling is evenly distributed to maintain shape. Embroidered eyes and nose eliminate suffocation risk from loose parts. Stitches are reinforced with double seaming. Includes origin label with craftsperson's name. Packaged in recycled cardboard box. A gift that will last for generations.

name: Bilingual Story Book PT/EN
description: Collection of 5 traditional Portuguese tales (The Puss in Boots, Beauty and the Beast, etc.) presented in bilingual pages PT/EN with original illustrations. Thick 250g paper. Suitable for ages 3-8.
full_description: This book was created for Portuguese families who want their children to grow up bilingual without losing touch with Portuguese literary tradition. Each double-page presents the text in Portuguese on the left and English on the right, with the same illustration. The stories were rewritten in language accessible to children, maintaining the essence of the original tales. The gouache illustrations were created by an Alentejo illustrator and feature a palette of warm and comforting colors. The 250g paper with matte finish resists children's handling. Dimensions: 25x25 cm, 96 pages.

name: Colorful Building Blocks 120 Pieces
description: Set of 120 building blocks in beech wood with 12 different shapes and 6 colors. EN71 certified, no toxic paint. Includes cotton storage bag. Develops spatial reasoning and creativity. From 18 months old.
full_description: Made in solid beech wood from Central Europe, these blocks are hand-polished to remove rough edges and guarantee a smooth surface for the child's touch. The 12 different shapes (cubes, cylinders, arches, triangles, parallelepipeds...) offer almost unlimited building possibilities. The 6 colors are made with water-based aqueous paints, certified Oeko-Tex and EN71 — completely safe if the child puts them in their mouth. The cotton bag facilitates storage and encourages the child to organize and categorize. Compatible with other standard wooden block sets. A toy to last generations.
